text:
pagerduty-bot: [ALERT] High GPU queue growth — region=us-east1, pool=primary-gpu, queued=1240, scaling_failed=true, incident=INC-2387
ava: paging oncall, taking lead — joining bridge now :wave:
sandeep: digging into autoscaler, seeing failures to provision VMs. cloud API returning quota errors (ZONE_RESOURCE_POOL_EXHAUSTED).
jess: console shows token/sec spike x4; pattern = many short seeds (~64 tokens) causing rapid KV-cache churn.
ava: any initial customer impact?
ops_mary: CS reports several customers with intermittent 502s and 10-15s tail latency. enterprise account X flagged. we've opened triage.
liam: initiating cross-region spillover to us-west1 to relieve us-east1 primary pool. applying routing override now.
infra-bot: runbook note: to force spillover run the routing override API. example: 
```
curl -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.internal/v1/routing/override -d '{"from":"us-east1","to":"us-west1","policy":"spillover-strict"}'
```
sandeep: autoscaler logs: scaleUpAttempt -> error: quotaExceeded (compute.projects.zones.insert) retrying backoff. cloud support ticket opened.
ava: if autoscaler can't add capacity, start evicting non-critical pools and throttle background/batch workloads. Jess can you throttle?
jess: throttled batch by ~70% (applied burst_control=conservative). PATCH sent to /config/batch: `{"max_concurrency":4}`.
liam: spillover metrics: traffic -> us-west1 +22% in last 3m; node CPU in west ~60%. us-east1 queued still ~900 but decreasing.
infra-bot: note: routing change will cause some cache-prefix invalidations; expect transient cache-miss surge for a small subset of keys.
ops_mary: CS update: one enterprise account saw ~6 minutes of degraded responses (~10s median) and 500s. escalation to credits team in progress.
sandeep: cloud quota increase request is in the queue with support; ETA unknown. we need mid-term mitigations.
ava: action plan: 1) keep spillover routing active, 2) maintain batch throttle, 3) evict lower-priority pools, 4) enable model fallbacks in-region, 5) external customer comms. objections?
jess: none. I'll gate canary rollouts and reduce hot-variant pressure.
liam: enabling temporary circuit-breaker for model=redwood-large in us-east1 to route to quantized fallback:
```
set-model-fallback --model redwood-large --fallback redwood-large-quant --region us-east1
```
ops_mary: drafting incident update for status page and customer outreach in #incidents-updates.
ava: handing over active monitoring to oncall @sandeep in 30m; I'll remain reachable for 15m. :pager:
sandeep: ack. setting new alert threshold: queued > 500 => page immediate. subscribing ops and infra.
infra-bot: metrics snapshot: us-east1 queue 98 (was 1240), us-west1 queue 320, primary-pool utilization down from 98% to 65% after spillover.
pagerduty-bot: [RESOLVE] Alert auto-resolve condition met (queue < 100) timestamp=2387654675
ava: closing thread — followups: CLOUD ticket ID CLOUD-8912 for quota, post-incident review scheduled, customer credits TBD. Thanks everyone.
